findings.problem: switch_start_form rules out a tag clash only; git resolves pseudo-refs, refs/<name> and a full sha before refs/heads, so an oddly named local branch (stash, remotes/origin/x, a 40-hex name) passes while the new branch starts elsewhere.
findings.scenario: A local branch remotes/origin/main exists: git switch -c feat/a remotes/origin/main gets no prompt and starts from the remote-tracking ref.

findings.problem: G22.011-020 use the same directory as payload cwd and hook process directory: a mutant dropping -C "$BASE_DIR" from the show-ref calls survives.
findings.scenario: show-ref run in the process directory instead of the pass's tree: suites green.
